statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Claude"'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // ""'); dir=$(basename "$cwd"); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); ctx=""; [ -n "$used" ] && ctx=" | ctx: $(printf '%.0f' "$used")%"; printf "%s | %s%s" "$model" "$dir" "$ctx"

hooks.prompt: Check if the Bash command in $ARGUMENTS was a 'git push' or a 'git checkout -b' / 'git switch -c' (a new branch was created or pushed). If it was a successful git push: find the open PR number for the current branch in litlfred/qou using mcp__github__list_pull_requests, subscribe to PR activity using mcp__github__subscribe_pr_activity, AND if any other open PRs in litlfred/qou were updated in the last 24h (sibling PRs), invoke the /coordinate slash command (skill: local/coordinate) so this session posts intent + scope on the relevant siblings and triages review comments on its own PR. If it was a 'git checkout -b' / 'git switch -c' on a non-main branch and origin/main is not already being watched in this session, invoke the /watch skill in branch:main mode. If neither, do nothing.
